You can send your ACE transcript via Credly. # Course Transfer and Transcripts Author: Sophia ## Table of Contents * Transferring the Sophia Course * Partner Colleges & Universities * Parchment * ACE Transcripts ## Transferring the Sophia Course Here are some tips to help you transfer the courses you took at Sophia Learning for credit. If you attend one of Sophia's partner institutions, you can see which courses transfer to your college or university by navigating to your institution's partner page and clicking on 'Courses.' If you are interested in taking a course that is not listed, please consult with an academic advisor from your college or university. If you do not attend one of Sophia's partner institutions, you will want to consult with an academic advisor from your college or university to determine which Sophia courses will transfer to your degree program. You can refer to the Sophia course catalog when making your inquiry. ## Partner Colleges & Universities If your account is affiliated with one of our university partners, in most cases your transcript will be automatically delivered to your college or university upon course completion. In a few other cases -- like Southern New Hampshire University (SNHU), for example -- you will need to follow the Parchment process outlined in the section below. See the complete list of our partners' transcript process ## Parchment If your account is not affiliated with one of our university partners, or is affiliated with a partner without an automated process, you may order your official transcript via Parchment. Parchment is a service that offers fast, easy, and secure electronic transcript delivery to your university. To do so, please follow the prompt to create your Parchment account. Once you have successfully created your account, follow the prompt to ‘order transcript,' enter intended recipient information, and include other required details as prompted to successfully send your transcript. Go to Sophia's page at Parchment ## ACE Transcripts You can send your ACE transcript via Credly. To do so, claim your Credly badge by clicking the ‘Get your Badge' prompt just below any completed course. Once you do so, follow the prompts to create or link your Credly account. Once you are in your Credly account, navigate to your profile settings, and send your transcript to your school from there. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- REQUESTING YOUR TRANSCRIPT (https://www.sophia.org/content/dam/sophia/sophia-guide-and-syllabus/sophia-student-guide.pdf) 【turn860search11】 [wordlim: 200] Published: 4.1 years ago; REQUESTING YOUR TRANSCRIPT ... • Official Sophia transcripts ordered through Parchment— required by some institutions (fee charged) • Official American Council on Education (ACE) transcripts, ordered through Credly REQUESTING YOUR TRANSCRIPT Once you have successfully completed a course, you may request an official transcript. Detailed course descriptions should include modules and content, progress-tracking metrics, credit hours, and learning objectives and outcomes.  Search in course catalogs or school websites for official course descriptions. These are official documents that help institutions evaluate course equivalency to what the receiving school already offers, and they are especially important for specialized or online courses.  ## Detailed Syllabi One layer deeper than a course description is the detailed syllabi. This will outline topics covered, weekly assignments, readings, grading criteria, textbooks used, exams, projects, and more.  A detailed syllabus helps demonstrate academic rigor and provides additional evidence that completed work is adequate to count toward required credits and degree requirements. Especially important for online courses, lab courses, prerequisites, and support-level courses, a syllabi should never be edited and should accurately reflect official data.  Save a copy of the course syllabus right away or before access to the course materials expires. Official transcripts must be sent directly from the previous institution(s) to the receiving school via a sealed physical envelope or electronically through approved systems like Parchment. ## What Is Sophia Learning and How Do Its Courses Work?  ### Understanding Sophia Learning Sophia Learning offers affordable, self-paced online courses designed to help students complete college-level learning on their own schedule. Whether you’re balancing work, family responsibilities, or a busy schedule, Sophia allows you to learn whenever and wherever it’s convenient.  You can choose from more than 80 courses for college covering many of the subjects commonly found in the first two years of college, including: * English Composition  * Mathematics * Biology  * Chemistry * Business  * Humanities * Psychology  * Information Technology When you successfully complete a course, you can request an official Sophia transcript for your preferred school to evaluate for transfer credit. Instead of awarding college credits directly, Sophia provides college-level courses that have been reviewed for credit, allowing participating schools to determine if and how they apply toward a degree.  ### ACE Recommendations and Credit Transfer Sophia courses have been evaluated by the American Council on Education (ACE) College Credit Recommendation Service. An ACE recommendation means independent faculty reviewers have determined that a course demonstrates college-level learning outcomes and recommends an equivalent number of semester credit hours. These recommendations help colleges evaluate whether coursework may be accepted for transfer.  However, it’s important to understand what ACE recommendations mean – and what they don’t. ACE recommendations:  * Demonstrate that coursework has been reviewed for college-level learning * Provide guidance to colleges when evaluating transfer credit  * Can support transfer eligibility ACE recommendations do not guarantee that every college will accept every course. Each institution has its own transfer policies and makes its own decisions.  Here’s how the credit transfer process works: ### 1. Complete Your Sophia Course Take as many courses as you like at your own pace. Every completed course can earn ACE-recommended credits. ### 2. Request Your Sophia Transcript Once you finish a course, you can request an official transcript directly through your Sophia account. Sophia sends transcripts electronically directly to partner schools. ### 3. Your School Evaluates the Course Every college has its own transfer credit policy. Most will review factors like: * Course equivalency * Degree requirements * How many transfer credits they allow Your school will let you know how the credits apply to your program. ### 4. Credits Are Added to Your Degree Progress Accepted Sophia courses will appear on your academic record and count toward graduation requirements, often saving you time and money. ## Why Choose Sophia? If you’re considering Sophia because of credit transfer, you’re in good company. Many students each year choose Sophia because it offers: ### Flexible, Self-Paced Courses Study anytime, anywhere – perfect for working adults, parents, active-duty military, or anyone needing to balance school with life. ### Affordable, Low-Commitment Learning Sophia is designed to be a cost-effective way to take college-level courses without committing to a full degree program or paying hundreds per course. ### Over 100 Partner Colleges and Universities for Seamless Transfer Partner institutions offer the easiest transfer pathways, but many non-partners also evaluate and may accept Sophia courses. ### Unlimited Courses with a Single Membership Take as many courses as you’d like, up to two at a time, allowing you to boost your degree progress at your own pace. ### Clear Pathways Toward Common Degree Requirements Sophia courses often align with general education requirements like English Composition, math, science, humanities, and electives, maximizing their transfer potential. They want to know where it came from, how rigorous the coursework was, and whether or not it aligns with their academic standards.  Missing documents can extend review timelines and may lead to additional follow-up requests. Avoid scrambling at the last minute and putting yourself through unnecessary delays by verifing that you have everything you need before you send it in.  This also helps the academic advisor know exactly what questions to ask you and how to best support your transfer. The last thing you want to do is repeat coursework or credits, and being as prepared as possible will help prevent that. Complete documentation is directly tied to a more seamless credit transfer experience and less frustration.  ## Official Transcripts Transcripts are a formal academic record that show what courses have been completed, the grades earned, number of credits or units, dates, and attendance, and degree or enrollment status. This is for both traditional schools and online college-level course providers like Sophia Learning. L125: L126: 【102†Take a free trial】 L127: # Grading Timelines in Online Learning: What You Need to Know L128: L129: Posted on January 15, 2026 L130: L131: By Sophia Learning L132: L133: Online learning is a great way to advance your knowledge while going through courses at your own pace. It’s a great way to supplement general education, achieve new certifications, and give you the resume boost you’re looking for when it’s time for a career change. L134: However, if you’re new to online learning, you’ve probably wondered how exactly course grading works. Maybe you’re unsure about what types of assignments you’ll get, how they’re evaluated, and what you should be prepared for when it comes to overall grading timelines. L135: L136: We’ll go over each of these details to give you a better perspective before starting your online learning journey. L137: ## Types of Assignments with Online Learning L138: L139: Taking courses online typically looks a bit different than what you’ll find in a traditional classroom setting. While each online course is different, and many have their own formats, most feature a mix of assignments and practical exercises designed for remote students. L140: L141: Some of the most common assignment formats you’ll see include: L142: ### Timed Tests and Quizzes L143: L144: Structured tests or quizzes are the most common types of assignments you’ll find in remote learning courses. At Sophia Learning, these are referred to as “Milestones.” These are typically 20-30 questions long, multiple choice and are designed to help gauge key concepts a student should have learned. L145: L146: Because these quizzes have fixed answers, they’re typically graded automatically on the platform and will provide an overview of how you scored shortly after taking the quizzes. L147: ### Written Assignments or Projects L148: L149: For more in-depth assignments that require more critical thinking, many courses include various written assignments or projects. At Sophia Learning, these are called “Touchstones.” These types of assignments give you the chance to apply what you’ve learned, usually by presenting you with real-world problems and allowing you to work through them. L150: These assignments are scored manually and will count toward your total course grading averages. The great thing about these types of assignments is that you can typically work on them at your own pace and have much more flexible turnaround times. L151: ### Discussion Boards L152: L153: Many online courses feature discussion boards where other students are able to connect and discuss different types of coursework. These environments are great for simulating traditional classroom environments and can help to deepen learning on different topics. L154: ### Proctored Exams L155: L156: Depending on the type of online coursework you’re doing, you may also have certain forms of proctored testing you’ll need to complete. These exams are typically monitored through a webcam or specialized software that verifies your identity and can ensure the integrity of your testing environment. This is usually reserved for final exams for courses or certifications that involve academic credit transfers. L157: Unlike traditional online programs, Sophia Learning has no proctored exams. All assessments are open book to support flexible, on-your-time learning. L158: ### Start a free trial no credit card required! L159: L160: Try a Sophia course for free. Your free trial work is applied toward course credit when you become a member. L161: L162: Get started today L163: ## How an Assignment is Graded in Online Learning L164: L165: After you’ve completed online course assignments, they’ll go through a grading process. The amount of time it takes for you to receive your grades will depend on the type of assignments you’re turning in. L166: * Multiple Choice Exams - In most cases, online courses already have the correct answers to multiple-choice questions hardcoded in their systems. This means your grades should be able to be displayed instantly after submitting an assignment or quiz, unless the platform uses a manual verification system, which could add to this timeline. L167: * Written Projects or Practical Assignments - Scenario-based or problem-solving practical assignments often use a human evaluator who will read, analyze, and provide feedback on the work you submit. Because of this, the grading typically takes longer and will usually average anywhere between a few business days and a couple of weeks, depending on the learning platform. L168: You’ll want to make sure you’re factoring in course grading timelines into your study plans. A good strategy for this is to create personal schedules for any written project work as soon as you reach them in the curriculum. This will help you to keep the momentum going in your coursework and avoid taking longer to complete your courses than actually needed. L169: ## How Long Will It Take to Grade My Sophia Learning Assignment? L170: L171: Your Sophia Learning grading time will depend on the type of assignments you’re turning in. When turning in different “Challenges” or “Milestones,” these will automatically register any correct or incorrect answers, so feedback is nearly instant L172: L173: For “Touchstone” assignments, these will require human review after they’re turned in. Sophia Learning grades most assignments within 72 hours.
